limitations: Final two-cell opportunity can expire with real callback latency; no hidden grace or acceleration. Exact boundary is tested with a deterministic clock; native timing exercises one-cell early turns.
Prototype tuning and long-gesture sampling comfort require independent QA and owner playtest.
Original selector comparison shares the protected-deadline scheduler; it does not restore the former timer-reset flaw.
Short layouts may require scrolling between board, status and controls.
No physical-browser zoom, refresh, OS interruption, screen-reader, WCAG or FPS certification.
